intro: Between 2026-04-16 and 2026-09-17, ZCyberNews published 18 articles tagged kaspersky. Coverage names CrystalX, GoSerpent, and HelloNet among the top threat actors, alongside the CVEs CVE-2019-0708 and CVE-2020-0688. The affected sectors span finance, government, technology, education, and energy, while the affected regions are Global, Russia, Southeast asia, Spain, and Africa. Fourteen of the articles carry a high severity rating, with one rated critical. The archive collects reporting on these actors, vulnerabilities, sectors, and regions as published across the five-month period.
